title: SMTP: add prometheus metrics module and /metrics route
description: SMTP crate has zero metrics. Add prometheus=0.14 to Cargo.toml. Create crates/smtp/src/metrics.rs with: SMTP_CONNECTIONS_TOTAL counter, SMTP_MESSAGES_ACCEPTED_TOTAL counter, SMTP_MESSAGES_REJECTED_TOTAL counter (label: reason), SMTP_DATA_BYTES_TOTAL counter. Instrument session.rs connection accept and DATA handler. Add GET /metrics route to the Sieve admin Axum router in sieve_admin.rs (no auth required for metrics). Use prometheus::TextEncoder.
